description: Receive email, with attachments, at a Project's own address.

serviceForm.label: Receiving domain
serviceForm.help: The Mailgun domain whose catch-all Route forwards every recipient to this service's webhook URL.

serviceForm.label: Webhook signing key
serviceForm.help: The Mailgun account's HTTP webhook signing key.

serviceForm.label: Largest attachment (MB)
serviceForm.help: Larger attachments are left out of the stored email and listed under omittedAttachments.

email.received.title: Email received
email.received.description: An email arrived at the Project's address.

address.description: The local part of the recipient address: the Project's address before the @.

fromHeader.description: The From header as written, display name included.

text.description: The plain-text body without quoted replies and signatures; usually the part to read.

bodyHtml.description: The whole HTML body, when the email has one.

attachments.description: The attachments stored as this Event's files, in order.

omittedAttachments.description: Attachments larger than the deployment's limit, not stored.
